scientific_integrity: The unrestricted result is proved by a cloning inequality, a directed-edge reversal condition, and a strict adjacent-class exchange. Exact small-instance integer checks corroborate rather than replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: Unit-weight complete multipartite edge-diamond Minkowski sums in the canonical coordinate Euclidean metric only. The original circle graphs C3 and C4 have overlapping earlier results. Historical priority beyond the inspected sources is not independently established.
title: Sharp Euclidean outer spheres and contact multiplicities for complete-multipartite edge-diamond sums
